title: Taskelith plugin manifest
description: The G1 subset of the plugin manifest in architecture section 7. Keywords stay within the subset shared by JSON Schema draft-07 and 2020-12.

id.description: Stable plugin identifier: lowercase letters, digits, and inner hyphens, starting with a letter.

version.description: Semantic version of the plugin package.

pluginApiRange.description: Supported plugin API versions as a caret range, for example ^0.1.0.

port.description: Name of the port the plugin implements, for example SdlcFramework.

capabilities.description: Declared protocol capabilities: lowercase letters, digits, and inner hyphens, starting with a letter.
